field.label: Area ID
field.help: Enter the area ID in dotted format, for example 0.0.0.0 for the Backbone Area. The Backbone Area connects other areas and supports inter-area communication, while additional areas, for example 0.0.0.1, segment the network logically to limit routing updates.

field.label: Area Ranges
field.help: Summarizes multiple networks in the specified area, consolidating multiple networks into a single summarized route like fe80:1234::/56.

field.label: Prefix-List In
field.help: Filters inbound route advertisements using a prefix list. Each option represents all entries with the same name.

field.label: Prefix-List Out
field.help: Filters outbound route advertisements using a prefix list. Each option represents all entries with the same name.
